card.name: Digits in prices before cents or percent
card.fires_on: Digits or number words inside an amount that is about to be followed by cents, percent or hours, as in 'approximately 6|0 percent' or '1|5 cents'. Mostly in general web text about prices, rates and money.

modes.label: Second digit of a number
modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit figure, just before 'cents', 'percent' or 'hour'.
modes.example: a first-run movie ticket in a neighborhood theater sold for 1<<5>> cents

modes.label: Small quantity word or digit
modes.description: A single digit, number word or 'few' placed directly before 'cents' or 'farthings'.
modes.example: twelve pence to a shilling and<< four>> farthings to a penny

card.plain: It fires on the digits of small price or rate figures, right before words like cents or percent.
